title: Root-Locus Design for Thermal Systems with Sinusoidal Flow Perturbations
expert_review: Excellent illustration of the internal model principle applied to thermal systems with periodic disturbances.
learning_objectives: Model thermal systems with time-varying flow rates
Apply the internal model principle to periodic signals
Design higher-order controllers using root-locus methods
Select controller zeros for stability and performance
Analyze disturbance rejection in feedback systems
